description: Your personal agents, under one roof. AgentStudio brings Grok Bot, Muse, Cue, Dots and any A2A or ACP agent into one local-first Mac app: talk to all of them in one inbox, and approve what they do before they do it. Open source, and nothing leaves your Mac.🏠
